projectDetail.portfolio-multilingue.desc: A fast, clear and multilingual portfolio designed to present a freelance activity with a professional image.
projectDetail.portfolio-multilingue.cont: The goal was to create a simple, credible and conversion-focused online presence to present web development services.
projectDetail.portfolio-multilingue.chal: The website had to stay easy to maintain, without a backend, while providing a clear multilingual experience and a premium look.
projectDetail.portfolio-multilingue.solu: Implementation of a Next.js architecture with local content, localized routes, reusable components and a lightweight design system.
projectDetail.portfolio-multilingue.resu: A fast, responsive and easy-to-evolve website aligned with the expectations of a modern freelance portfolio.
projectDetail.dashboard-saas.title: SaaS dashboard
projectDetail.dashboard-saas.description: A modern admin interface to manage data, display indicators and connect an API.
projectDetail.dashboard-saas.context.des: The project focuses on designing a clear web application base to manage business data in a SaaS environment.
projectDetail.dashboard-saas.challenge.d: The interface had to be readable, fast and ready to evolve with new features.
projectDetail.dashboard-saas.solution.de: Creation of a Next.js frontend structure connectable to a Laravel API, with modular components and clear logic.
projectDetail.dashboard-saas.result.desc: A solid base to build an administrable, maintainable and scalable web product.
projectDetail.site-vitrine-premium.title: Premium showcase website
projectDetail.site-vitrine-premium.descr: An elegant, fast and optimized showcase website to present a professional activity.
projectDetail.site-vitrine-premium.conte: The need was to create a simple, credible and pleasant website to present a service offer.
projectDetail.site-vitrine-premium.chall: The website had to be lightweight, fast and clear, without unnecessary complexity.
projectDetail.site-vitrine-premium.solut: Design of a modern layout with readable sections, visible CTAs, clean responsive behavior and basic SEO optimization.
projectDetail.site-vitrine-premium.resul: A professional showcase ready to convert visitors into leads.
